(ba)༄༅/ /gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i mchod brjod dang bsngo ba bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' la mngon 'phags shing*/

tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i mchod brjod dang bsngo ba bzhugs// ༄༅// chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' la mngon 'phags shing*// ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor rnam par rgyas// legs bshad zer gyis gdul bya sad mdzad pa// bla ma skye dgu'i sgron la bdag skyabs mchi// bsod nams gser gyi dbang chen rab brtan zhing*// thugs rje'i chu gter zab cing rgya che ba// ye shes lhun po'i rgyal pos nyer mdzes pa// sangs rgyas rnam par rgyas pa'i rgya mtshos rgyal// rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho las 'khrungs shing*// snang dang rtogs pa'i 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gnas// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa// dam chos rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dpal la mngon brten zhing*// dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen gter bzung nas// 'gro ba'i dbul ba ma lus rnam sel ba// dge 'dun klu dbang 'dus pa'i zhabs la 'dud// de ltar bsam pa dge bas kun bslangs nas// bsod nams zhing gi mchog rab dam pa la// nye bar bsgrubs pa'i mchod rdzas dri med 'di// kun bzang rnam 'phrul ji bzhin blos sprul nas// kun nas mchod pas mchod 'os thams cad ni// mchod pa kun gyis kun nas mnyes gyur nas// bdag dang bdag gi grogs gyur 'gro ba kun// kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan gyis legs gzigs te// thugs rje'i thugs kyis nye bar dgongs nas kyang*// mthu stobs dam pa'i stobs kyi dbang bgyis nas// srid dang rnam par grol ba'i dpal 'byor gyis// kun nas 'byor zhing dga' mgur spyod bgyi'i phyir// chos tshul rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams legs gsungs shing*// thun mong ba dang phul du byung ba yi// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gang lags pa// gegs med par yang nye bar stsal du gsol// de ltar mchod 'os rnams la legs mchod cing*// gsol bar 'os la tshul bzhin gsol ba las// kun tu dri med kun nas rgya che ba'i// dge ba gang zhig bdag gis bskrun pa dang*// gzhan yang bdag gzhan kun gyis dus gsum du// rnam par dag pa'i dge ba gang bsgrubs pa// lhag bsam dag pas gcig tu bsdoms byas shing*// shes rab snying rje'i grogs kyis dbang byas pas// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das pa yi// mtha' rnams kun la rnam par mi gnas par// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis// kun mkhyen rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog

/de srid srid par las dang smon lam gyis// srid pa'i tshul yang srid par sbyor ba na// yon tan bdun dang ldan pa lha mo'i lus// dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thob gyur nas// yang dag bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung ste// thabs mchog zab mo'i lam la nyer zhugs nas// chos tshul ji bzhin rab tu spyad byas te// rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byed par shog /rgyal dang rgyal sras bshes gnyen thams cad las// gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams legs thos nas// chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la// rgya chen chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog /rnam par grol ba'i lam du zhugs gyur nas// ting nge 'dzin dang de bzhin dpal 'byor pas// skye ba dam pa nye bar len pa na// skye bo kun skyob skye ba mchog thob shog /mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par// skad cig re la'ang spyod pa rgya mtsho yis// 'phags pa mchod dang sems can smin byed cing*// zhing khams rgya mtsho yongs su sbyang bar shog /de ltar byang chub lam kun rdzogs byas te// rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho cher zhugs nas// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i// sems can thams cad yongs su sgrol bar shog /skye ba 'di nyid du yang tshe ring zhing*// nad med pa dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs// bar du gcod pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub par shog /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid dang ni// yongs su bzung dang spyod pa'i sgo nas ni// mchod par 'os pa thams cad mnyes pa dang*// skye dgu kun la phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mi yi gtso rnams dul bar gnas pa dang*// skye dgu rnams kyang tshul lugs legs spyad cing*// phan tshun yid gcugs byas pa shes pa yi// 'jig rten lugs kyi 'jig rten bde legs shog /sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor// dam pa'i chos ni nges par 'byin pa'i mchog

/dge 'dun 'dus pa rnams kyi mchog gyur pa'i// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /chos skyong ba rnams gzi brjid dpal gyis lham// 'jig rten skyong ba 'jig rten dpal gyis 'byor// bden par smra ba bden pa'i mthu ldan pa'i// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /phyogs skyong ba yis phyogs mtshams bde legs byed// 'byung ba'i lha yis 'byung ba dbang sgyur zhing*// dus kyi lha yis dus tshigs kun bsrung ba'i// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing dang ni// bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba dang de bzhin du// bde legs byed pa'i rdzas rnams thams cad kyis// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /chos dbyings spros pa zhi ba'i bden pa dang*// rten 'byung rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i bden pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum mchog gyur pa'i bden pa yis// bdag gi ji skad brjod bzhin 'grub par shog /gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu tham pa phul ba'i dus kyi mchod brjod dang bsngo ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
